items.docs:
Displays all the accounts registered in the system.

Each account consists of
  - id: unique ID
  - created_at: creation date
  - updated_at: date of updating process
  - name: name associated with the payroll item
  - number: number
  - type: [general, bono, descuento, credito, aporte, tipo_sobretiempo]
  - format: [detalle, resumen]
  - document_type: document type
  - group_code: grouping code

**Permisos requeridos para utilizar este endpoint:** 
* Accounting permissions en: 'Lectura'.
